 The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Wednesday appointed economist Karthik Muralidharan as chief econ- omist and director general of the Economic Research and Development Impact Department. He will succeed incumbent Albert Park and assume office on July 1, 2027. “Muralidharan brings the expertise and leadership we need as our members face increasingly complex devel- opment challenges,” ADB President Masato Kanda said. Muralidharan is presently the Tata Chancellor’s Profes- sor of Economics at the Uni- versity of California, San Diego. In his new role, he will lead ADB’s economic research, policy analysis and forecast- ing for Asia and the Paciﬁc. He will also oversee the bank’s ﬂagship economic publication, the ‘Asian Devel- opment Outlook’. His research covers public ﬁnance, educa- tion, health, social protec- tion, governance and public service. shubham kumar ADB appoints Muralidharan chief economist
